tasks.prompt: Orient a new engineer to this repository using structural evidence. Return the indexed class count, bean count, configuration-definition count, service-descriptor count, dependency-index status, and the highest-ranked architecture hub.

Measure the inbound static coupling of io.casehub.api.model.CaseDefinition across production and test bytecode. Return its module, unique fan-in, incoming edge count, and source/generated dependent-class breakdown.

Analyze the configManager field injection in io.casehub.engine.internal.engine.DefaultCaseDefinitionRegistry. Return its resolution status and reason, selected candidate FQCN, confidence, and excluded-candidate count.

Inspect the ServiceLoader descriptor for io.serverlessworkflow.impl.executors.CallableTaskBuilder. Return its repository path, provider count, ordered provider FQCNs, and whether provider order can affect execution according to static analysis.

Inspect up to 100 commits touching the root pom.xml. Return the commits in the requested window, total indexed commits for that file, distinct author-label count, and sorted author labels. Do not merge identities or infer people.
Inspect io.casehub.engine.internal.quarkus.RuntimeBeans. Return its module, class scope, producer-method count declared by that class, and total bean entries associated with the class.

Find every compiled implementation of io.casehub.engine.common.spi.CaseDefinitionRegistry. Return implementation count, source/generated counts, sorted modules containing implementations, and whether choosing one depends on application context.

Assess tests affected by changing io.casehub.engine.internal.engine.DefaultCaseDefinitionRegistry with transitive depth 3. Return the total ranked candidates, indexed test-class count, coverage status, direct depth-one test count, and sorted direct test classes.

Find production HTTP endpoints for /actors/{actorId}/state across supported frameworks. Return endpoint count, sorted frameworks, sorted handler classes, HTTP method, and whether every handler has exactly one direct project call.

Inspect configuration access by io.casehub.engine.internal.config.impl.QuarkusConfigManager. Return usage count, definition count, key classification, resolution status, resolution strategy, and whether configuration values are indexed.
Check production project modules for dependency cycles using direct project dependencies. Return analyzed edge count, cycle count, and the cycle semantics used.

Find conservative unused production-class candidates in the runtime module, excluding generated and test classes. Return analyzed-class count, candidate count, sorted candidate classes, confidence shared by the candidates, and the result classification.
Assess the change risk of io.casehub.engine.internal.engine.DefaultCaseDefinitionRegistry. Return risk score and level, unique fan-in and fan-out, and the source file that would be edited.
Map runtime module visibility to depth 2. Return sorted direct inbound modules, direct outbound modules, transitive inbound modules, and transitive outbound modules.

Trace the direct bytecode flow of io.casehub.actorstate.ActorStateResource.getActorState(String). Return direct callee FQCN and method, invocation kind, source evidence line, emitted call-event count, whether control flow is straight-line, and async-boundary count.
